name: Mockup Master
tagline: High-Fidelity Mock Data Injector & Headless ADB CLI Generator for Android Developers.
description:
Mockup Master is a developer utility for Android engineers, QA teams, and UI designers. It populates physical devices or emulators with realistic mock Contacts, SMS/MMS threads, and Call Logs for UI stress-testing and demonstration.

Architected with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room DB, Firebase Remote Config, and ADB Broadcast CLI Engine.

Core Capabilities:
- Headless ADB CLI Automation: Trigger mock data generation headlessly from terminal scripts (adb shell am broadcast) using CliCommandEngine for CI/CD test automation.
- Contact Injection Factory: Bulk create realistic contacts with full names, phone numbers, email addresses, avatars, and country phone formats (Country.kt).
- SMS & MMS Conversation Builder: Create full multi-turn conversation threads (ConversationBuilderScreen) with Sent, Received, and Draft statuses.
- Call Log Factory: Inject Incoming, Outgoing, and Missed call entries with realistic durations and human-like time distribution (HumanTimeSpacingEngine).
- One-Tap Surgical Cleanup: Track generated records (InjectedRecordRegistryImpl) to safely wipe mock data without touching personal device records.
- Data Portability Engine: Export and import mock scenarios as JSON or CSV files (DataPortabilityEngine) for reproducible test environments.
